Real-Time Human Detection

Monitor prohibited areas with intelligent surveillance

About the Project

Our system detects human presence in prohibited and strictly prohibited zones using a neural network model. Triggers alarms based on activity levels.

Key Features

Prohibited Area

Detects suspicious activity and triggers an alarm accordingly.

Strictly Prohibited Area

Triggers an alarm immediately upon detecting any human presence.

Video Monitoring

Upload and analyze video footage using a trained neural model.

Start Monitoring

Select area type and upload video to analyze activity in real-time.
